verdict.rationale: Bitwarden has an official, first-party MCP server (bitwarden/mcp-server). A runtime probe confirmed `npx -y @bitwarden/mcp-server` completed a full stdio initialize handshake and identified itself as 'Bitwarden MCP Server' 2026.7.0, so an agent can connect to it. The evidence stops at the handshake and the repo pointer, with no documentation of the exposed tools or how authentication works. Missing for 10: documented tool surface and capabilities, auth/vault-unlock setup guidance for agents, independent or community hands-on corroboration of real agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
